BJP Mahila Morcha Protests Congress MP Akoijam Over JNU Row

The BJP Mahila Morcha organized protests in multiple locations, including Delhi and Srinagar, on Monday, demanding the expulsion of JNU professor Akoijam. Protesters also burned effigies of Rahul Gandhi, the leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha. The demonstrations were related to the JNU row and harassment allegations against Akoijam.
